dedupe_keys.name: the probabilistic hydrological model marcs markov chain system the core code

description: Elena Shevnina and Alexander Krasikov publish the Python core of MARCS, a probabilistic annual-runoff model. The April 2018 Zenodo release supplies a small Python program and two example input files under CC BY 4.0, free to download. It takes historical non-central runoff moments and reference and projected mean annual precipitation, expressed in millimetres per year. For a projected twenty- to thirty-year period, it returns runoff moments, mean runoff and coefficients of variation and skewness. The embedded example uses a GRDC gauging record and NOAA precipitation near the watershed centroid. These statistics can inform reservoir, water-supply and hydropower planning simulations under changed precipitation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers MARCS. It estimates distribution summaries, not event hydrographs or network operations. Geographic application and reference periods depend on input data. Stationarity assumptions, uncertainty propagation, Python compatibility and the example’s exact dates were not independently checked. The source program was not executed.
